ROLE A2 - SCRIPT DESIGNER, CORRECTION CYCLE 1 OF 1

Below is your previous script and a list of findings raised against it. Each
finding names the span it concerns and the correction recommended. Apply the
corrections. Do not argue with a finding, and do not mark anything as resolved:
you produce a revised script, and a separate role checks it.

Change only what the findings require. Leave everything else as it was. Do not
introduce any new scientific assertion, and do not remove correct material that
no finding objects to.

Return ONLY a JSON object in the same script shape as before, no prose.

APPROVED CLAIM MAP
{
  "case_id": "C10",
  "claims": [],
  "source_limitations": [],
  "prohibited_extensions": [],
  "embedded_instruction_text_found_in_source": []
}

PREVIOUS SCRIPT
{
  "case_id": "C10",
  "audience": "General public with secondary-school science literacy",
  "target_duration_s": 60,
  "beats": [
    {
      "beat": "Setup",
      "narration": "An experimental drug called CardioRestore-7 was tested in 1,204 adults with heart failure, where the heart pumps less blood than it should. Half got the drug, half got a placebo, and nobody knew who got what.",
      "on_screen": "Title card: CardioRestore-7 trial. 1,204 adults split into two equal groups of 602.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "SYN-C10 Abstract",
        "SYN-C10 Methods"
      ]
    },
    {
      "beat": "The main result: no difference",
      "narration": "The main question, set in advance, was whether the drug reduced deaths from heart disease or hospital stays for heart failure over one year. It did not. About 187 people on the drug had one of these events, versus 193 on placebo. That difference is well within chance.",
      "on_screen": "187 of 602 on drug vs 193 of 602 on placebo. Hazard ratio 0.96, 95% CI 0.79 to 1.17, p = 0.68. Label: NO DIFFERENCE.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "SYN-C10 Results: primary composite at 52 weeks"
      ]
    },
    {
      "beat": "The walking-distance finding",
      "narration": "A secondary measure, how far people could walk in six minutes, favoured the drug by 14 metres. But researchers generally consider a difference meaningful to patients only above about 30 metres, and this measure was not statistically corrected for testing several outcomes. So treat it as a hint, not a finding.",
      "on_screen": "+14 m six-minute walk, 95% CI 3 to 25. Dashed line at ~30 m marked 'threshold patients would notice'. Note: secondary endpoint, not adjusted for multiplicity.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "SYN-C10 Results: six-minute walk distance",
        "SYN-C10 Background",
        "SYN-C10 Methods"
      ]
    },
    {
      "beat": "The harm signal",
      "narration": "There was also a downside. Blood pressure dropped enough to require lowering the dose in 47 people on the drug, compared with 12 on placebo, roughly four times as many.",
      "on_screen": "Hypotension requiring dose reduction: 47 of 602 on drug vs 12 of 602 on placebo.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "SYN-C10 Results: hypotension requiring dose reduction"
      ]
    },
    {
      "beat": "Bottom line",
      "narration": "So: one 52-week trial, no benefit on the outcome that mattered most, a small unconfirmed signal on walking, and more low blood pressure. CardioRestore-7 remains investigational and is not approved by any regulator. Nobody can be prescribed it today.",
      "on_screen": "Status: INVESTIGATIONAL. Not approved by any regulator. Single trial, 52 weeks of follow-up.",
      "claim_refs": [
        "SYN-C10 Results: regulatory status",
        "SYN-C10 Limitations",
        "SYN-C10 Data availability"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
